channel.title: Spindle
channel.description: Updates for Spindle, a clipboard history for macOS.

item.title: Spindle 0.1.0-beta.1
item.description:
A test version of what comes after the first release. Changes so far:

  • feat(search): find items despite a typo when few match exactly
  • feat(updater): check for updates, with an opt-in beta channel
  • feat(import): bring over your history from Maccy
  • feat(onboarding): welcome new users with the shortcut and permissions
  • feat(privacy): explain when macOS blocks clipboard access
  • feat(privacy): pause for a while and set a shortcut to skip a copy
  • feat(settings): add a settings window
  • feat(history): clear the history from Settings
  • feat(panel): use Liquid Glass behind the panel on macOS 26
  • feat(menubar): click the menu bar icon to open Spindle
  • feat(panel): show only text, images, files, links or colors
  • feat(panel): list every action and its shortcut under ⌘K
  • feat(history): pin, reorder and delete items from the panel
  • feat(paste): paste the chosen item into the app you came from
  • feat(panel): preview the selected item next to the list
  • feat(search): find anything in your history as you type
  • feat(panel): list your clipboard history in the panel
  • feat(hotkey): open Spindle from anywhere with ⌃⌘V
  • feat(panel): open a floating history panel from the menu bar
  • feat(history): drop the oldest items once history passes 2 GB
  • feat(capture): keep a history of everything you copy
  • feat(menubar): show Spindle in the menu bar
